highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and a WinUI Projection DLL fix.

bullets.lead: Apple library and app TFM alignment backported
bullets.detail: Library targets now use versioned 26.0 TFMs while app targets use the unversioned form, matching the Apple SDK alignment already shipped in v4.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: Consumers using the WinUI projection on .NET 9 no longer encounter a DllNotFoundException when loading the projection assembly.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFM alignment from v4.
